title: Per-channel & Headwise Quant Profile Synthesis + Cross-model Calibration Harness
creator: Asha Raman
description: Goal: produce model-specific quantization profiles (FP8/INT8) that explicitly handle per-channel and per-head outliers for Llama, Mistral, and Qwen families, and build a reproducible cross-model calibration harness to validate accuracy across evaluation suites. Background: existing single-scale per-layer calibrations show regressions for certain models (head spikes, final-layer attention tails). This ticket proposes a synthesis approach that combines: 1) per-channel activation histograms, 2) headwise tail detection and attenuation, and 3) a per-layer inertial rescale filter that preserves dynamic range but clamps transient spikes. Deliverables: - A calibration harness that runs deterministic probes and collects per-tensor statistics for candidate kernels (FP8/INT8). - Profile synthesizer that proposes quant scales per-channel and per-head, plus suggested clamp multipliers for layers with high transient kurtosis. - Automated accuracy validation pipeline that runs our Redwood eval set (microsuite + longitudinal prompt sets) and reports token-level perplexity, exact-match where applicable, and fidelity deltas vs. FP16 baseline. - A set of production-ready profiles for one model each: Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-14B. Acceptance criteria: - Avg perplexity delta <= 1.0% and max delta <= 3.0% vs FP16 baseline on Redwood core evals for each model. - No catastrophic failure cases (e.g., repeated hallucinations on templated prompts) after 5000 sample checks. - Profiles packaged as runtime-1.20 artifacts with metadata and automated rollbacks on >2% live-regression if run in canary.
notes: This is an engineering-heavy effort that interfaces with model-onboarding, runtime kernel selection, and Console rollout tooling. Expect coordination with research for probe set design and with product for acceptable fidelity thresholds.
